current_bottleneck: The continuous low-frequency scaffold is live, but the current basis path is too smooth and too weakly mean-reverting. It preserved change law and materially improved level-law fidelity, yet under-reverted badly and weakened worst-cell cointegration robustness. The next decision is how to sharpen scaffold path shape without falling back into the old support-codebook tradeoff.
last_result_summary: Iteration 150 ran 294a-v0. The new continuous low-frequency scaffold baseline scored 3/11 and changed the failure mode materially: change KS stayed perfect, level KS improved to 9/25, cross-cell structure stayed strong, and the old over-reversion pathology disappeared. But mean reversion collapsed in the opposite direction, worst-cell cointegration robustness worsened, and jump realism stayed weak.
next_step_recommendation: Do post-experiment analysis of 294a relative to 293h, then ideate 294b as one narrow follow-up inside the continuous scaffold family to make the scaffold less overly smooth without returning to support codebooks.
